{"lean_source":"import Std

namespace MedianStream

inductive Operation where
  | add : String → Int → Operation
  | remove : String → Operation
  | median
  deriving Repr, DecidableEq

abbrev Input := List Operation
abbrev Entry := String × Int
abbrev Entries := List Entry
inductive Output where
  | empty
  | rational : Int → Nat → Output
  deriving Repr, DecidableEq
abbrev Results := List Output

def A1 (ops : Input) : Prop := ops.length ≤ 100

def lookup (entries : Entries) (id : String) : Option Int :=
  match entries with
  | [] => none
  | (key, value) :: rest => if key = id then some value else lookup rest id

def removeId (entries : Entries) (id : String) : Entries :=
  match entries with
  | [] => []
  | (key, value) :: rest =>
      if key = id then removeId rest id else (key, value) :: removeId rest id

def setId (entries : Entries) (id : String) (value : Int) : Entries :=
  match entries with
  | [] => [(id, value)]
  | (key, old) :: rest =>
      if key = id then (id, value) :: removeId rest id
      else (key, old) :: setId rest id value

def values (entries : Entries) : List Int := entries.map Prod.snd

def sortedValues (entries : Entries) : List Int := (values entries).mergeSort (· ≤ ·)

def median (entries : Entries) : Output :=
  let xs := sortedValues entries
  match xs.length with
  | 0 => .empty
  | n + 1 =>
    if (n + 1) % 2 = 1 then
      match xs[n / 2]? with
      | some value => .rational value 1
      | none => .empty
    else
      match xs[n / 2]?, xs[n / 2 + 1]? with
      | some left, some right => .rational (left + right) 2
      | _, _ => .empty

def step (entries : Entries) (op : Operation) : Entries × Option Output :=
  match op with
  | .add id value => (setId entries id value, none)
  | .remove id => (removeId entries id, none)
  | .median => (entries, some (median entries))

def run (entries : Entries) (ops : Input) : Entries × Results :=
  match ops with
  | [] => (entries, [])
  | op :: rest =>
      let (next, result) := step entries op
      let (finalEntries, later) := run next rest
      match result with
      | none => (finalEntries, later)
      | some output => (finalEntries, output :: later)

def solve (ops : Input) : Results := (run [] ops).2

def hasId (entries : Entries) (id : String) : Prop := lookup entries id ≠ none

def exactlyLatestValue (before after : Entries) (id : String) (value : Int) : Prop :=
  lookup after id = some value

def removePresent (before after : Entries) (id : String) : Prop :=
  hasId before id → lookup after id = none

def removeAbsentUnchanged (before after : Entries) (id : String) : Prop :=
  ¬ hasId before id → after = before

def queryCount (ops : Input) : Nat := ops.countP (fun op => match op with | .median => true | _ => false)

def rationalReducedPositive (out : Output) : Prop :=
  match out with
  | .empty => False
  | .rational _ denominator => denominator > 0

def oneEntryPerId (entries : Entries) : Prop :=
  ∀ id : String, ∀ first second : Int,
    (id, first) ∈ entries → (id, second) ∈ entries → first = second

def equalValuesKeepSeparateIds (entries : Entries) : Prop :=
  ∀ id₁ id₂ : String, ∀ value : Int,
    id₁ ≠ id₂ → (id₁, value) ∈ entries → (id₂, value) ∈ entries

def stdlibPureDeterministic : Prop := True

def exampleOne : Input :=
  [.median, .add "a" 1, .add "b" 4, .median, .add "a" 7, .median, .remove "b", .median]

def exampleTwo : Input :=
  [.remove "missing", .add "x" (-2), .add "y" (-1), .median]

def missingRemovalKeepsGoing (entries : Entries) (id : String) (rest : Input) : Prop :=
  run (removeId entries id) rest = run entries rest

theorem O1 : ∀ ops : Input, A1 ops → ∀ before after : Entries, ∀ op : Operation,
  step before op = (after, (step before op).2) →
  (match op with
   | .add id value => exactlyLatestValue before after id value
   | .remove id => removePresent before after id ∧ removeAbsentUnchanged before after id
   | .median => after = before) := by sorry

theorem O2 : ∀ entries : Entries,
  (entries = [] → median entries = .empty) ∧
  (entries ≠ [] → ∃ numerator : Int, ∃ denominator : Nat,
    median entries = .rational numerator denominator ∧
    rationalReducedPositive (.rational numerator denominator)) := by sorry

theorem O3 : solve exampleOne = [.empty, .rational 5 2, .rational 11 2, .rational 7 1] ∧
  solve exampleTwo = [.rational (-3) 2] := by sorry

theorem I1 : ∀ entries : Entries, oneEntryPerId entries := by sorry

theorem E1 : stdlibPureDeterministic := by sorry

theorem E2 : ∀ entries : Entries, ∀ id : String, ∀ rest : Input,
  ¬ hasId entries id → missingRemovalKeepsGoing entries id rest := by sorry

theorem A1_nonvacuity : ∃ ops : Input, A1 ops := by sorry

def outsideStatedSchemaBehaviorRequired : Prop := False

end MedianStream
